subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice selector land Android-first using existing gateway agent/session state, or wait for a shared Android/iOS/macOS Talk UX decision?
rationale: Current source proves the Android Voice/Talk gap, but choosing platform scope, selector semantics, and session-state persistence is a product/UX decision rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Add a focused Android Voice/Talk selector that reuses existing gateway agent/session data and leaves per-agent voices on `agents.list[].tts`.

options.title: Shared companion-app UX first
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers choose one Talk/Voice selection model across Android, iOS, and macOS before implementation.

options.title: Fold into Chat selector work
options.body: Treat the open Android Chat selector PR as adjacent groundwork only after it is made mergeable and explicitly extended to Voice/Talk routing.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Add a focused Android Voice/Talk selector that reuses existing gateway agent/session data and leaves per-agent voices on `agents.list[].tts`.

likelyOwner.reason: They already triaged this issue and implemented the shipped per-agent TTS half, so they are the clearest owner for separating canonical TTS config from remaining Talk/Voice UX direction.
